rv.q: Engaging, deliberately paced take on the classic study of class conflict and cruelty
The resulting tragedy has a snarling, pent-up energy.
Marber's reimagining may be the best of them all, its psychosexual dynamics teetering on a 70 minutes long tightrope.
When the tensions fail to ignite, the emotional core remains hidden, leaving a sense of promise unfulfilled.
In just under seventy minutes, this production delivered a textbook lesson in precision.
Marber's adaptation remains thought-provoking and thematically rich.
